sectors.trend: Iron ore under pressure; gold and base metals exploration positive. Forrestania WA gold prefeasibility, Aurum Côte d'Ivoire 3.22 Moz resource, Dalaroo copper-nickel-PGE targets signal exploration upside. Iron ore 'roaches seethe' suggests weak pricing.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term iron ore headwinds. Gold miners (NVS.AX, GSG.AX) and explorers (FOR.AX, AUR.AX, DAR.AX) benefit from discovery news. Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: Big four banks advance on ASX as oil and bond yields ease. However, RBA hawkish stance and Fed hike raise funding costs. Mortgage rates near 7% pressure NIMs and loan growth. States face soaring interest costs.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX benefit from wider spreads but face credit risk as affordability crunches. State-guaranteed debt (via sovereign) pressures fiscal space. Monitor RBA decision closely.

sectors.trend: Crude oil drops sharply as Houthi disruptions ease. LNG pricing distorted by Japan arbitrage ('hoses Aussie gas all over'). Petrol price shock hits consumers. Victoria backs away from renewable transmission. Coal policy uncertainty.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX face volatile LNG pricing. BHP.AX energy division mixed. Renewable/transition names (INC.AX, LNC.AX) hit by Victoria policy reversal. Coal (BLL.AX, WES.AX) faces political headwinds.

sectors.trend: Coles retains milk price premium despite axing farmer support. Housing 'absurdly unaffordable'. Qantas strike risk. Fashion brands Cue and Veronika Maine face collapse. Petrol shock pressures household budgets.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WSG.AX face margin pressure from input costs. QAN.AX exposed to industrial action. Consumer discretionary (SGH.AX, LPX.AX) under pressure. Defensive staples (WOW.AX, CBA.AX) relatively resilient.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn Queensland datacentre deal signals major AI infrastructure buildout. AI data-centre innovators attract investor attention. AI job displacement concerns persist but near-term impact limited.
sectors.implications: GRO.AX, WCN.AX, and data-centre REITs benefit from AI capex cycle. Anthropic deal boosts QLD infrastructure and power demand. Long-term structural tailwind for tech infrastructure.

sectors.trend: Mortgage rates near 7% and housing unaffordability pressure residential REITs. ACCC moves to break real estate agency monopoly. Tenants catch a break on rental conditions.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICOL.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure. Residential REITs under stress. Commercial REITs (VMC.AX, SPG.AX) more resilient. ACCC action may benefit tenants, pressure agency revenue.

defensive_moves.rationale: 7% mortgage rates and 'absurd' affordability suppress demand; ACCC regulatory risk on agency model

defensive_moves.rationale: 2027 recession probability increasing; IMF fiscal tightening; RBA further hikes likely; preserve capital for entry points

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to mildly negative. RBA hawkish warning and Fed hike create headwinds, but bank strength and oil easing provide support. Qantas strike and Coles pricing disputes add volatility. Expect 1-2% downside risk into RBA decision.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautious. 2027 recession odds rising, 7% mortgage rates, and IMF fiscal calls suggest a slower growth path. However, AI infrastructure capex (Anthropic $31bn), WA resources exploration, and commodity diversification offer structural pockets of growth. ASX 200 likely to underperform global indices but dividend yield remains attractive.
key_catalysts: Fed next meeting and dot plot revision
watch_list: RBA cash rate and statement (next meeting)
